notablePrerequisites:
You control at least one additional creature.
Plaguemaw Beast does not have summoning sickness.
description:
Activate Plaguemaw Beast by tapping it and sacrificing a creature, causing you to proliferate.
Venser triggers, creating a legendary 3/3 The Hollow Sentinel artifact creature token.
The Hollow Sentinel enters the battlefield, triggering Intruder Alarm, untapping all creatures.
Repeat.
